en.headline: New family medicine clinic in Siu Sai Wan to open on 1 August
en.dek: The Hospital Authority said the clinic at Siu Sai Wan Health Centre will provide doctor consultations, preventive screening, chronic disease management and vaccination services for Eastern District residents.
body: The Hospital Authority announced on Tuesday that the Siu Sai Wan Family Medicine Clinic will begin service on Saturday 1 August. The clinic is located on the second floor of Siu Sai Wan Health Centre at 11 Fu Yan Road, Chai Wan.

It will operate under the family medicine model, offering comprehensive primary care including doctor consultations, preventive screening and nursing, chronic disease management, vaccination and health education. The authority said the new facility will work with five existing family medicine clinics in the Eastern District to strengthen one-stop primary care services.

Patients currently receiving chronic disease follow-up at the five Eastern District clinics will be notified of arrangements to transfer to the new clinic where appropriate. Appointments for episodic illness can be made by telephone or through the HA Go mobile app. Clinic enquiry number is 3865 7451.

zh.headline: 小西灣家庭醫學診所8月1日起投入服務
zh.dek: 醫管局表示，位於小西灣康健綜合大樓的新診所將提供醫生診症、預防篩查、慢性疾病管理及疫苗接種等服務，加強東區基層醫療。
body: 醫院管理局星期二公布，小西灣家庭醫學診所將於8月1日（星期六）投入服務。診所位於柴灣小西灣富欣道11號小西灣康健綜合大樓二樓。
診所採用家庭醫學服務模式，提供醫生診症、預防篩查及護理、慢性疾病管理、疫苗接種及健康教育等全面基層醫療服務。醫管局指，新診所將與東區現有五間家庭醫學診所互相配合，進一步加強一站式基層醫療服務。
部分現時於東區五間家庭醫學診所定期覆診的慢性疾病病人會獲通知安排轉往新診所繼續治療。市民如需預約偶發性疾病診症服務，可致電3153 2930或透過HA Go手機應用程式辦理。診所查詢電話為3865 7451。
